name: Distinct Engineering Solutions, Inc. (DESI)
what_they_do: Multidisciplinary civil engineering firm covering geotechnical, environmental/LSRP remediation, site-civil and permitting, construction quality and special inspections, hazmat (asbestos/lead/mold) and noise/vibration consulting. Runs an AASHTO-accredited soil and concrete testing laboratory in NJ.
customers: Public and private sector developers, builders, municipalities and industrial owners across NJ, PA, NY and CT.

size_signals.signal: Employs over 30 staff, many licensed Professional Engineers, including a NJ Licensed Site Remediation Professional
Founded 2008; main office North Brunswick plus satellite offices in New York and Connecticut
AASHTO-accredited, NYSDOB-approved materials testing laboratory; ACEC NY Diamond-level awards cited
Dedicated Careers page plus News and Blog sections

listing.reviews: Count not shown on the Maps panel

website_review.primary_cta: OUR SERVICES button in the hero; no call or quote CTA above the fold
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form with labelled required fields (name, email, phone, company, city, message); no quote or booking flow
website_review.trust_signals: Seven service pages, project and client pages, team page, awards page, DBE/MBE certification page, accredited lab claim
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Nothing obviously stale; hero text sits over a busy construction photo, reducing contrast on mobile
website_review.search_basics: Title reads 'Distinct esi – Civil Engineering New Jersey NJ'; meta description empty; no LocalBusiness JSON-LD; each service has its own page (geotechnical, environmental, hazmat, noise/air, special inspection, site civil)
top_issues: Google rating is 2.1 with no photos, and no review-request or reputation workflow is visible on the site
Meta description empty on home and contact pages
No LocalBusiness JSON-LD despite a full services and multi-state presence
Contact form includes a honeypot field ('Please do not fill in this field') that can silently drop automated enquiries

agent_readiness.notes: Listing appears claimed (shows 'Closed · Opens 9 AM' rather than a claim prompt) but is weak: no photos and a 2.1 rating. robots.txt excludes only wp-admin, leaving Googlebot/OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot allowed. Services and the multi-state service area are real text; no JSON-LD blocks found. Contact page has four tel: links and a labelled form, but the honeypot makes unattended agent submission risky and there is no scheduling.

operations_signals.signal: Careers page exists, implying ongoing hiring and onboarding load
Corporate summary highlights a 'paperless office' push and an extranet for client collaboration (inference: document-heavy workflow is a known cost centre)
A 2.1 Google rating with no review-response or solicitation workflow visible drags on new-business conversion (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Reputation recovery: review-request automation after project milestones plus a response workflow for the 2.1-rated Google profile
top_opportunities.evidence: Google rating 2.1 with no photos; the site has no review or testimonial capture anywhere

top_opportunities.opportunity: Give each of the seven service lines its own quote-request path (service-specific intake form or qualifying chat) instead of one generic contact form
top_opportunities.evidence: Seven distinct service pages all funnel into one generic contact form, while geotech, hazmat and special-inspection buyers need different scoping questions

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService JSON-LD and real meta descriptions naming services and North Brunswick
top_opportunities.evidence: Zero JSON-LD blocks and empty meta description on home and contact pages

scores.reasons: Gap: solid site overall, but reputation is the standout problem and schema/meta are missing. Ability: 30+ staff, four states, accredited lab, high-ticket engineering work. Ease: review automation and schema are short engagements. Evidence: corporate summary, contact page, home page and Maps panel inspected.
